title: Idolem Hot Yoga Chaud
specs: Studios heated to 37°C with infrared heating that heats body and objects, not air
Yogic spa circuit includes cold plunge baths at about 4°C, halotherapy, relaxation lounge
Accessible to people aged 16 and over; minors must be accompanied by an adult
Not recommended for pregnancy, uncontrolled hypertension, heart problems, or heat intolerance
No sharing of subscriptions between people
Corporate packages available with discounts and on-site or online classes
includes: Access to indoor hot yoga classes
blurb: Guests practice hot yoga in heated studios with qualified teachers, accessible to all levels including beginners. The experience includes access to a yogic spa circuit with cold plunges, halotherapy, relaxation lounges, and beverage bars at select studios. Packages offer multi-studio access and virtual yoga options, with various durations and visit counts.
extraNote: Cancellation free of charge up to 2 hours before class start; after that, session deducted from package · No late arrivals allowed after class start; arrive 10 minutes early recommended · Packages activate upon first visit, not purchase date · Memberships require minimum 6-month commitment; max 4-week pause allowed · At the studio location where the package was purchased or chosen · Offers and outdoor classes available May through November 2026; packages valid up to 3 years
